metadata.description: Harnesses, plugins, and skills for development workflows, media management, and conversational alignment.

harnesses.name: david
harnesses.description: David's personal full-stack development persona with Go, infra, and conversational alignment skills

harnesses.name: researcher
harnesses.description: Research and analysis persona for investigating codebases, APIs, and technical topics

harnesses.name: ynh-dev
harnesses.description: Development harness for the ynh project — Gitflow workflow with Go language support

harnesses.name: termq-dev
harnesses.description: Development harness for the TermQ project — Gitflow workflow with Swift/SwiftUI language support

harnesses.name: gitflow
harnesses.description: Gitflow branching model: develop/main strategy, conventional commits, quality gate, tag-driven release automation, and push/PR workflow.

harnesses.name: media-management
harnesses.description: Process downloaded music purchases: extract, tag, import to Apple Music, stage to NAS.

harnesses.name: vendor-harness
harnesses.description: Lifecycle management for LLM vendor harness artifacts — validate, diagnose, feedback, and keep current across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Copilot CLI.

harnesses.name: github
harnesses.description: Reads GitHub for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: review requests, your PRs' reviews and checks, mentions and assigned issues. Read-only.

harnesses.name: slack
harnesses.description: Reads Slack for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: unanswered DMs and mentions, and threads where you asked and got no answer. Read-only.

harnesses.name: gmail
harnesses.description: Reads Gmail for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: threads whose last message is to you, and threads where you sent last and got no reply. Read-only.

harnesses.name: google-calendar
harnesses.description: Reads Google Calendar for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: unanswered invites, pending replies to your invites, and meetings that need preparation. Read-only.

harnesses.name: google-drive
harnesses.description: Reads Google Drive for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: comments on your documents, comments that mention you, and documents you shared for comment. Read-only.

harnesses.name: imessage
harnesses.description: Reads Messages (iMessage and SMS) on a Mac for who is waiting on a reply, catching up on a thread, finding what was said and what you promised. Read-only; shows only as much text as the job needs.

harnesses.name: triage-skills
harnesses.description: Triage skills: what is waiting on me, what am I waiting on, and what to act on now or soon, answered in one shape on any platform.

harnesses.name: platform-skills
harnesses.description: Platform skills: how to work well in a specific tool through its MCP server. Today: Slack, GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive.

harnesses.name: voice-skills
harnesses.description: Voice and reply-style skills: describe how you sound, compose several voices, and shape a reply for each platform.
